title: Zesty British Iceberg Lettuce Salad
description: Salty, crumbly and kid-friendly salad packed with iceberg lettuce, cheddar, bacon and a zesty dressing.
instructions: Place grated cheddar, crumbled bacon, sliced red onion, capers, lemon zest, parsley, and a pinch of salt in a mortar.
Add a splash of olive oil and gently pound the mixture to release aromas and soften textures.
Whisk together red wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, black pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil until a smooth dressing forms.
Toss the chopped iceberg lettuce in a large bowl, then pour the dressing over the leaves and gently lift with a spoon to coat evenly.
Sprinkle the mortared cheese-bacon mixture over the lettuce.
Gently fold the salad to combine all components without bruising the lettuce.
Taste and adjust seasoning with extra salt or pepper if desired.
Serve immediately in individual bowls or on a platter for kids to enjoy.
Garnish with extra lemon zest for a bright finish.
Keep any leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 24 hours.
